content.value_statement: Building a new FlowGram workflow node by hand requires wiring up schema, form rendering, registration, and icons across several files. This skill gives Claude ready-made templates and a step-by-step guide so it can scaffold both simple and complex nodes correctly.
actual_capabilities: Explains the FlowGram node data model: inputsValues, inputs, and outputs.
Provides a simple-node template that auto-generates a form from a JSON Schema.
Provides a complex-node template with custom form rendering and React components.
Documents the seven-step flow: plan, choose mode, copy template, add constant, register, add icon, test.
Maps field types to default form components (Input, InputNumber, Switch, JsonCodeEditor).
limitations: Applies only to the FlowGram demo-free-layout application structure, not arbitrary projects.
Templates contain TODO placeholders that must be edited by hand before use.
It does not implement backend execution logic for the node; it scaffolds the editor UI only.
Guidance and templates are written primarily in Chinese.

use_cases.title: Add a simple config node
use_cases.description: A developer adds an LLM-style node whose form is generated automatically from a JSON Schema.
use_cases.target_user: Frontend developer working in the FlowGram demo app

use_cases.title: Build a complex custom-UI node
use_cases.description: A developer creates an HTTP-style node with a hand-built form layout and custom components.
use_cases.target_user: UI engineer needing full control over node rendering

use_cases.title: Onboard a new contributor
use_cases.description: A team lead uses the templates and checklist to help a new contributor register a node consistently.
use_cases.target_user: Engineering team lead onboarding new members

prompt_templates.title: Scaffold a simple node
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the create-node skill to scaffold a simple FlowGram node named Delay with one number field for milliseconds.

prompt_templates.title: Scaffold a complex node
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the create-node skill to create a complex node named Webhook with a custom form containing a URL input and a method selector.

prompt_templates.title: Register an existing node
prompt_templates.prompt: I copied the complex-node template into src/nodes/database. Update constants.ts and index.ts to register the Database node and add its icon reference.

prompt_templates.title: Design node schema and outputs
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design the inputs, inputsValues, and outputs JSON Schema for an HTTP request node with required url and method fields and a response body output, then generate the complex-node files.

output_examples.input: Scaffold a simple FlowGram node named Delay with a number field for milliseconds.
output_examples.output: The skill copies the simple-node template into a new index file, replaces the placeholder names with Delay, and defines a number field with sensible minimum and maximum values, ready to register.

output_examples.input: Create a complex Webhook node with a custom form.
output_examples.output: The skill produces an index file, a form-meta file, a types file, and a component file, then lists the constant and registration edits needed to activate the node in the app.

best_practices: Give each node a single, clear responsibility and a well-defined inputs and outputs schema.
Choose the simple template when the default auto-generated form is enough, and the complex template only when custom layout is required.
Complete every TODO placeholder and register the node in constants and index before testing.
anti_patterns: Do not manage form state with local React state; use the Field component to bind form values.
Do not leave inputsValues fields that are missing a matching definition in the inputs schema.
Do not use the complex-node template for a node that only needs a few standard fields.

faq.question: When should I use a simple node instead of a complex node?
faq.answer: Use a simple node when the fields are basic and the default form layout is enough. Use a complex node when you need custom layout, special interactions, or custom components.

faq.question: What are inputs, inputsValues, and outputs?
faq.answer: inputs is the JSON Schema that defines the form structure, inputsValues holds the actual saved field values, and outputs is the JSON Schema describing the node's execution results.

faq.question: How do I mark a field as required?
faq.answer: List the field name in the required array of the inputs JSON Schema.

faq.question: What image formats do node icons support?
faq.answer: Node icons support SVG, JPG, and PNG. SVG is recommended.

faq.question: Does this skill run any commands or access the network?
faq.answer: No. The skill only provides documentation and template files. It does not execute commands or make network requests on its own.

faq.question: What language are the skill instructions written in?
faq.answer: The guidance and templates are written mainly in Chinese, with standard English code identifiers.
